fields.name: name
fields.coerce: none: used as a key of `G.skills`
fields.description: The skill. It selects the variant. **Server bug:** the lookup is on a plain object, so `"toString"` and `"constructor"` pass the checks and get the default success with no effect (node/server.js:9788). If `name` is missing, failures have `place: "skill"`.

confirm.note: The shared checks read `name`; each variant lists the other fields it reads

variants.intro: The emote, `ids`, `targets`, target, `slot` and `consume` checks run in the shared checks, before the variant. They apply to the skills that `G.skills` marks (`emote`, `target`, `slot`, `consume`), so each variant lists only the request fields that its skills read.

list.name: Emote
list.when: An emote skill (`emote` in `G.skills`). Spends the MP of the emote. Clients nearby get `emote`. During the anniversary, `ikissyou` on the featured character can claim a reward. The checks of emotes (ownership, `no_self`, friend, `ikissyou` target) are in the shared checks.

fields.name: id
fields.coerce: `"" + parseInt(id) === "" + id` means a monster id, else a character name
fields.description: The target, for an emote with `target` in `G.skills` (`boop`, `highfive`, `ikissyou`, `spotlight`). Other emotes ignore it.

responses.name: Kiss
responses.when: Every `ikissyou` that passes the checks: the server always asks the anniversary controller (`anniversary_state()` never returns null). With no event running, `claim` fails, so the reply is `rewarded: false, reason: "no_round"` without `message`. Other emotes get the default success.

fields.name: success
fields.description: Always `true`. The kiss works also when there is no reward.

fields.name: rewarded
fields.description: `true` when this kiss claimed the reward of the round.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: `null` when `rewarded` is `true`. Else why there is no reward: `"no_round"`, `"claimed"`, `"realmfatigue"`, `"hopsickness"`, `"merchant_home"`, `"host"`, `"no_visit"`, `"target_unavailable"` or `"wrong_target"` (node/logic/anniversary_event.js:53-107).

fields.name: message
fields.description: Only when there is no reward and the target is the featured character of the round: the English text of `phrase`.

example.message: You already received this round's kiss rewards and buff.

confirm.note: `anniversary_state()` always returns the controller, so every `ikissyou` that passes the checks gets `rewarded` and `reason`

responses.name: Kiss condition
responses.when: `ikissyou` with `rewarded: true`: `claim` gives you the condition `anniversary_kiss` (20 min) and removes your `anniversary_visit`.

also.when: An emote skill passes the checks.

fields.name: target
fields.description: The target. Absent for an emote without a target.

list.name: Attack
list.when: `commence_attack`: a projectile to the target. `curse` adds party DPS credit on success. A `commence_attack` failure keeps the cooldown free.

fields.name: id
fields.coerce: `"" + parseInt(id) === "" + id` means a monster id, else a character name
fields.description: The target: a monster id or a character name. A number or a string. `"052"` is a character name; `52` and `"52"` are a monster id (node/server.js:9903). `undefined` or `null` fails with `no_target`.

fields.name: num
fields.coerce: none: used as an array key, so `3` and `"3"` are the same
fields.description: The slot of the item of `consume` (`poisonarrow`: `poison`, `snowball`: `snowball`) to use. If `num` is `undefined` or `null`, the server uses the matching item in the highest slot (node/server.js:10036-10053).

responses.name: Attack
responses.when: `commence_attack` succeeds. The object is the `Action` plus `response` and `place`. It has no `success` field. `selfheal` gets this reply too (you are the target).

confirm.note: `eta` is always present: 0 for an instant projectile, which also gets `instant: true`

rows.when: `commence_attack`: your instance or the instance of the target is paused. No cooldown starts.
`commence_attack`: you or the target is a cave actor, and the cave rules say that the target is not hostile.
`commence_attack`: you are a merchant, and the skill has no `merchant_use` (only `snowball` has it). `attack` with a `dartgun` passes.
`commence_attack`: `mode.pvp_level_gap` is on (only on the `HARDCORE` server), the target is a character, the skill is hostile, and your levels differ by more than 10.
`commence_attack`: a hostile skill on a character that is not in a PvP area, or any of these skills on an NPC.
`commence_attack`: `attack` and your `mp` is less than your `mp_cost`; or `burst` and your `mp` is less than 1.
`commence_attack`, except `attack` and skills with `pierces_immunity`: the target is `immune`. Clients near the target get `disappearing_text` "IMMUNE!".

`commence_attack`: a hostile skill, and you are on a `safe` map; or the map is `duelland` and you or the target is not in the duel; or `mode.friendly_fire` is off (it is on, node/server.js:286) and the target is in your party or guild.

also.when: The target is `immune`: "IMMUNE!" on the target.

fields.name: y
fields.description: The position of the entity, minus 30.

Adds `invis` if you are not invisible now. If you are invisible now, no branch runs (the generic path, as for **Other**): you get the default success. The cooldown (`reuse_cooldown`) starts when you become visible again (node/server.js:13756-13767).

rows.when: You are `marked` (and not invisible now).

fields.name: request_id

fields.coerce: `parseFloat(x) || 0`

fields.name: y
fields.coerce: `parseFloat(y) || 0`

fields.name: in
fields.coerce: none: used as a key of `instances`

fields.name: direction
fields.coerce: strict `in_arr(direction, [1, 2, 3])`: the string `"1"` gives 0
fields.description: The direction that the character faces after the teleport (`s.blink.d`).

rows.when: No instance has the name `in`.
The instance has a different `mount` than your instance (for example the bank).
No safe spot near (`x`, `y`) in that instance.

list.name: Target buff
list.when: Adds the condition of the skill to the target. `mluck`: not when the target has a `strong` `mluck` from another merchant; the buff is `strong` when the target is on your account.

fields.name: id
fields.coerce: `"" + parseInt(id) === "" + id` means a monster id, else a character name
fields.description: The target character. A value that looks like a number (`52`, `"52"`) counts as a monster id and fails with `invalid_target` (node/server.js:9903-9909). `undefined` or `null` fails with `no_target`.

also.when: Always.

list.when: Moves MP from you to the target, and adds `energized`.

fields.name: id
fields.coerce: `"" + parseInt(id) === "" + id` means a monster id, else a character name
fields.description: The target character. A value that looks like a number (`52`, `"52"`) counts as a monster id and fails with `invalid_target` (node/server.js:9903-9909). `undefined` or `null` fails with `no_target`.

fields.name: mp
fields.coerce: `max(1, min(your mp, parseInt(mp) || 10000))`
fields.description: The MP to give. The server also limits it to the MP that the target is missing, so it can be 0 (node/server.js:10915-10919).

rows.when: Your `mp` is 0.

also.when: Always.
Always: `"-<mp>"` on you and `"+<mp>"` on the target.

fields.name: y
fields.description: The position of the entity, minus 30.

list.when: Removes one unit of the first item without `l`, and gives you its value times the rate in gold.

responses.name: Gold received
responses.when: Always, after the `player` update. The default success follows.

fields.name: gold
fields.description: The value of one unit of the first item without `l`, times a rate of 0.8 (below level 50) to 1.12 (level 100 and up). Not rounded, so it can have a fraction; your `gold` gets the same fraction. `0` when no item was found.

also.when: Always.

list.when: Each respawn timer within 160 px gets `time * 0.85 - 1000`.

responses.name: Temporal surge
responses.when: At least one respawn timer is within 160 px. The default success follows.

fields.name: times
fields.description: The new time left of each timer: `old * 0.85 - 1000`. It can be negative (the monster respawns at once).

rows.when: No respawn timer is within 160 px. The MP and the cooldown are spent.

also.when: One for each respawn timer that changed. The payload is a bare string of client code, not `{code}`.

list.name: Other
list.when: Any other key of `G.skills` (and `invis` while you are invisible): no branch runs. These keys have none: `stop`, `use_hp`, `use_mp`, `use_town`, `stack`, `mtangle`, monster skills such as `fireball`, and `utility` keys such as `esc`. They pass the shared checks and get the default success with no effect, but a skill with a `cooldown` starts it (`use_hp` and `regen_hp` start the `use_hp` cooldown). **Server bug:** `"toString"` and `"constructor"` also get here (node/server.js:9788).

fields.name: id
fields.coerce: `"" + parseInt(id) === "" + id` means a monster id, else a character name
fields.description: Read only by the shared checks, for a skill with `target` (`mtangle`).

confirm.note: No branch matches; only the shared checks read the request

responses.name: Success
responses.when: The default reply: all checks pass, and the variant sets no other reply. Every variant without a reply of its own gets it.

confirm.note: `resolve` is built by hand, not by `success_response`, so it never has `request_id`

failures.intro: A failure has `place` = the skill (the `name` of the request), not `"skill"`. If `name` is missing, `place` is `"skill"` (`fail_response` falls back to the event name). These are the shared checks, in order; then the checks of the variant run. A failure in the shared checks costs no MP and starts no cooldown. The rows of each variant say when the MP or the cooldown is spent.

rows.when: No character.
You are disabled: dead (`rip`), or `stunned`, `fingered`, `stoned`, `deepfreezed` or `sleeping`.
The skill is not `attack`, and you wear the `konami` skin or are silenced (`silenced`; a disabled character counts as silenced).
`name` is not a key of `G.skills`.
`name` is `rimeshell` or `rimeshatter` (monster skills).
The skill is `3shot`, `5shot` or `fanofknives`, and `ids` is not an array, or a kept entry is not a string or a non-negative safe integer.
The skill is `cburst`, and `targets` is not an array, or one of the first 16 entries is not a pair of a valid id and a number or numeric string.

`ikissyou` (the only emote that the anniversary code reads) that your account does not own (`p.acx`), unless you are a guest of the featured character. `anniversary_state()` always returns the event controller, so this form applies also when no anniversary event runs (then `reason` is `"no_round"`).

extra.name: message
extra.example: This round's rewards are only for kissing the featured player.

rows.when: An emote skill other than `ikissyou` that your account does not own (`p.acx`).
Your `mp` is less than `G.skills[name].mp * (100 - mp_reduction) / 100`. A GM can `blink` with no MP.
Your level is less than `G.skills[name].level`.

The skill is on cooldown. A skill with `share` uses the cooldown of the shared skill times `cooldown_multiplier`. A skill with only `reuse_cooldown` (`invis`, `pickpocket`, `fishing`, `mining`) uses that.

extra.name: skill
extra.description: The `name` from the request (not the shared skill).

extra.name: id
extra.description: The `id` from the request. Absent when the request has none.

rows.when: The skill has a `class` list, your class is not in it, and you are not a GM.
The skill has a `wtype`, and the item in your `mainhand` is not of that type (or the slot is empty).
The skill has an `offhand_type` (`shield_slam`: a shield), and your `offhand` is not of that type.
The skill is `hostile`, and your map is `safe`.
The skill has a `target`, and `id` is `undefined` or `null`.
The kind of `id` (monster id or character name) is not the kind that `G.skills[name].target` allows (`"monster"`, `"player"`, or `true` for both).
A `hostile` skill, and `id` is your own name.
No character has that name, and no monster with that id is in your instance.
The target is invisible (`invis` or `ethereal`), or more than `B.max_vision` (1,000 px) from you. A `global` skill (`magiport`) skips the distance part.
An emote skill with `no_self` (`highfive`, `ikissyou`), and the target is you.
An emote skill with a target: the target is in another instance; or, except for `ikissyou`, the target is not in your party, not on your account and not a friend of your account.
The skill is `ikissyou`, and the target is an NPC, disconnected, dead or at 0 HP; or you are dead; or the target is on another map or farther than 80 px.
The skill has `requirements` (character stats, for example `mentalburst` needs `int` 64), and one of your stats is lower.
The skill has a `slot` list, and you do not wear any of the listed items in the listed slot.
The worn item has `charge` in `G.items`, and its `charges` are less than that. If it has enough, the server takes the charges here, also if a later check fails.

The target is farther than the range: the `range` of the skill (else your `range`), times `range_multiplier`, plus `range_bonus`, plus your level for `throw`, plus your `xrange` (not for a `fixed_range` skill). Before this check, the server removed your `invincible` condition.

extra.name: dist
extra.description: The distance to the target in px.

rows.when: A skill with `consume`: the slot `num` (or, without `num`, every slot) does not hold that item. If it does, the server removes one.

also.when: A skill that uses `commence_attack` (the variants Attack, selfheal, cburst, partyheal, Multi-shot, Cleave) starts a projectile: one `action` for each hit. Every client whose view holds you, and the target.

confirm.note: `xy_emit(attacker, "action", action, target.id)`: clients that see you, and the target

also.when: Later: each projectile arrives, after `eta` ms.
also.summary: The result of the hit. Look for the `pid` of the `Action`.

confirm.note: The payload of `hit` is in its own entry

also.when: After the variant, when the skill has a `cooldown` (a skill with `share`: the shared skill). Not after a `commence_attack` failure of a single-target skill, and not for skills with only `reuse_cooldown` (`invis`, `pickpocket`, `fishing`, `mining`: they get it later from the effect).

fields.name: name
fields.description: The skill whose cooldown starts. For a skill with `share` it is the shared skill (`3shot` gives `attack`, `quickstab` gives `quickpunch`).

also.when: When the skill changed your state (MP, conditions, items, position). Usually after `skill_timeout`. Some variants send it earlier (`blink`, `cleansing_light`, `guardians_oath`, `mluck`, `rspeed`, `reflection`, `energize`, `alchemy`).
also.summary: Your new state. `reopen: true` after an item was used or thrown, or gold changed. Its `hitchhikers` can hold `skill_immune`.

also.to: each character that the skill changes
also.when: A skill that changes another character: buffs (`mluck`, `rspeed`, `reflection`, `energize`, `guardians_oath`, `beacon_of_resolve`, `darkblessing`, `warcry`), `cleansing_light`, `4fingers`, `entangle`, `huntersmark`, `stomp`, `throw`, `revive`, a pull by `magiport`.
also.summary: The new state of that character, sent to its own socket.

also.when: Any skill that spends MP through `consume_mp`, when the `restore_mp` attribute roll hits: you get twice the MP back instead of paying.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: The MP added: 2 times the MP of the skill.

order: the events of the variant: `action`, `emote`, `ui`, `light`, `disappear` or `magiport` to others; `track`, `eval`, `magiport_sent`, `gold_received`, `temporalsurge`, `charm_failed` to you
`skill_timeout` to you (when the skill has a `cooldown`)
`player` to you (when your state changed; some variants send it earlier)
`game_response` to you: the reply of the variant, else the default success
later, `hit` for each projectile, and the result of a channel (`pickpocket`, `fishing`, `mining`, `revive`)
